stories.title: Last kick
stories.content: We kept playing because Leon said the next goal wins and then he scored but it was offside, except you can't really be offside with four people and a dog. So then Josh scored. I mean Leon again. I was in goal and the light had gone so I heard it hit the metal fence but didn't see where. We'd moved the jumpers already becuase the council guy was mowing the other bit and now nobody agreed how wide the goal was. My phone was buzzing inside my shoe. Mum probably. Leon hit it so hard the ball got through the broken fence into the private tennis bit. He said we could climb. I said he could climb. The lights in the tennis place came on and there was a man already holding our ball.

stories.title: the bridge
stories.content: The bridge was only two planks and both of them moved when I put my foot down. Connor said don't look down which made me look down. It wasn't even that far. Just a ditch with nasty water and a trolley in it. He jumped and and landed on the other side and then came back because he'd forgot his bag. Now I had to go first AGAIN. I took a run up but stopped so late my foot went through the mud and I lost the trainer. Left one. It just stayed there like it was someone's foot.

stories.title: oranges
stories.content: At the end they tip the oranges out and that sound is so nice, all the little thuds together. I can't desribe it properly. Soft but heavy.
